steps.fact: The left referent billing:Helion Robotics Limited is billed under the name Helion Robotics Limited.
The right referent contract:MSA-HELION-2019 names Helion Robotics Ltd. as its counterparty.
Helion Robotics Ltd (CRM operating name) and Helion Robotics Limited (invoices and Companies House) are the same legal entity.
billing:Helion Robotics Limited and contract:MSA-HELION-2019 therefore denote the same legal counterparty.

support_claim: Invoices bill Helion Robotics Limited, MSA-HELION-2019 names Helion Robotics Ltd. as counterparty, and commercial notes explicitly state those two names are the same legal entity.
